quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026) consolidated results: net sales JPY 29,672 million, up 4.6% (FY2025: JPY 28,356 million); operating profit JPY 12,156 million, up 15.6%; ordinary profit JPY 12,447 million, up 14.0%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 9,074 million, up 21.0%. Management states that in electronics, active investment in server-related fields led by generative AI continued to drive market growth and high-performance devices such as smartphones and PCs were solid, raising shipment volumes.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 29,672 million (+4.6%); operating profit JPY 12,156 million (+15.6%); net profit JPY 9,074 million (+21.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals Business, FY2026: net sales JPY 26,926 million (+11.5%), segment profit JPY 12,716 million (+19.1%). Management's analysis of the electronics field: in Taiwan, demand for semiconductor package substrates for high-performance devices such as smartphones and servers was strong and chemicals sales rose substantially year on year; in China, demand for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates for smartphones, PCs and other high-performance devices was strong and chemicals sales rose; in South Korea, the bottoming of the semiconductor market and progress in customers' inventory adjustment continued a gradual recovery in package substrate demand and chemicals sales rose. Decorative field: Japan flat, China up on higher auto production.
quarterly_data.figure: Chemicals net sales JPY 26,926 million (+11.5%); segment profit JPY 12,716 million (+19.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, FY2026: R&D expenses JPY 1,241 million, all allocated to the Chemicals Business. In electronics the company is strengthening its main processes for high-density PWBs and semiconductor package substrates (smartphones, PCs, servers): via-filling copper sulfate plating and etching solutions for fine-line wiring. It positions semiconductor advanced packaging as its next-generation area and semiconductor package substrates as its focus area, where demand is expected to keep growing with AI and IoT; the newly established Kumamoto site has a state-of-the-art research facility dedicated to next-generation-area R&D.

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's strategy: it expects demand for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates to expand over the medium to long term with AI, IoT and autonomous driving, while the decorative field (auto parts) is expected to stay flat on changing design trends and EV adoption. Under the medium-term plan JCU VISION 2035 - 1st stage (fiscal years ending March 2025 to March 2027), it will keep investing actively in the package substrate focus area and the advanced packaging next-generation area, accelerating R&D with a two-site structure (Central Research Institute plus the new Kumamoto site), aiming to be a world-leading niche-top company.
